summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundle
details: @servicetitan/cp-mfe@1.115.1 declares a `preinstall` lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXX` identifier renaming and per-function string-key maps that hide constants including `--version`, `/etc/os-release`, `bun`, and the download URL fragments. The script downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB `@bun @bun-cjs`-compiled bundle further obfuscated with a string-array rotation helper (`WV8StW`) and an alphabet-substitution decoder (`hc1jfK9`); its behavior is not statically readable and it is executed by a runtime that Node-based scanners do not inspect. The declared purpose of the package (a browser React/mobx portal store) has no need for the Bun runtime or install-time execution. The combination of an obfuscated lifecycle script, a fetched alternate runtime, and an obfuscated bundle executed under that runtime is an alternate-runtime install-time execution pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
